text_block_list.text:
After our outing, right as I walked
Haru Urara back to the front of the dorms—

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
You know, I remembered that I really wanted to eat
that "Carrot Taiyaki" I saw in town!!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text: I got so caught up doing other stuff that I totally forgot!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
Hey, hey, let's go eat right now!
Trainer!
choice_data_list: Let's save that for next time.

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
Eeeh?! No way!
My tummy is telling me it wants to eat right now!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
Wait, huh!?
Something smells super good!?

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
Ah! That smells like carrot curry!
It's dinner time! I've gotta hurry home!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
Sorry, Trainer!
We'll have to get "Carrot Taiyaki" next time!
Just dozens of seconds after she rushed back, a cheerful cry of "Looks so good!" echoed from the dorms.

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
Yay!
I've been dying to try this!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
"Oh, wait, do the shops
close once night falls!?"
Haru Urara sprinted off toward the shopping district with unprecedented speed.
